title: Derelict pod
text: A scout spots a second escape pod half-buried in the dunes. Its beacon is still blinking.

choices.label: Strip it for parts
choices.result: The pod gives up its plating and wiring.

choices.label: Search for survivors
choices.result: One survivor, frostbitten and grateful, joins the colony.

title: Signal fragment
text: The terminal picks up a repeating pulse from somewhere far above the planet. It is not random.

choices.label: Decode it
choices.result: The pattern is mathematical: prime gaps, then something that looks like a map.

choices.label: Record and move on
choices.result: The scholars argue about it for days. Their other work sharpens.

title: Solar storm
text: Auroras burn across the sky. The arrays are taking a beating.

choices.label: Fold the arrays
choices.result: The panels are safe. The colony runs dark for a while.

choices.label: Ride it out
choices.result: The storm overcharges the cells, and cracks a few panes.

title: Cold snap
text: The temperature drops another twenty degrees overnight.

title: Vent fever
text: Three harvesters come back from the vents coughing. It is spreading.

choices.label: Quarantine
choices.result: The sick are isolated. Work slows, nobody dies.

title: Pre-crash cache
text: Miners break into a sealed room. Someone lived here before the crash. Long before.

choices.label: Take the tools
choices.result: The tools fit human hands perfectly. Nobody likes that.

choices.label: Study the walls
choices.result: The carvings describe a sun that once burned much brighter.
